name: tb7_idle_mc
description: TB7 Monte Carlo: terminated idle inputs (VID = 0) on three lanes with device mismatch (each lane draws its own offset), VIC 0.05 / 1.2 / 2.35 V; the output must hold a stable state (no oscillation, no pulse < 2 ns); the fraction of lanes held HIGH shows where the random offset puts the idle state. Deck, prep and post are those of tb7_idle (drift off).
